title: Trace retention settings and Clear all traces
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData and run ⌘J once so a trace exists
In Settings › AI › Activity set Keep for to 7 days and untick Write and rewrite (⌘J) under Features to trace
Run ⌘J again, then press Clear all traces… and confirm
expected: The second ⌘J run adds no new row. Clear all traces asks first; after confirming the list says No AI requests yet. The settings stay as set after quitting and relaunching.
